name: Pokhara
targetGeometryEvidence: No parcel geometry was returned by the official Pokhara municipal service. The unchanged WUP point was not shifted and no point-hit or citywide-absence inference was made.
registryBasis: Pokhara Metropolitan City publishes an official parcel-level land-use search system with administrative filters and parcel number results. It is a local municipal service, but it is not an open geometry service and does not expose a stable native parcel identifier in the observed response.

schemaAndCrs: Municipal JSON schema observed: total/gavisList for init; search data fields sn, palika, gavis, ward, sheet, kitta, land_use plus total/page/limit/totalPages. No CRS or geometry was exposed.
nativeIdentity: No stable native identity was exposed. The response field sn is a display serial number and was not retained or treated as a native parcel key. The combination gavis+ward+sheet+kitta is a source-record lookup composite, not asserted as a globally stable identity.
safeFieldAllowlist: administrative parcel lookup fields: gavis, ward, sheet, kitta, land_use
unsafeDataPolicy: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, legal-description, or ownership fields were requested or retained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or certificate exception was used.
blocker: The evidenced local service is a parcel-level land-use lookup but exposes no anonymous parcel geometry, CRS, or stable native parcel ID suitable for a geometry adapter.
remainingUncertainty: The Department of Survey Kaski site may expose additional services, but its linked host failed TLS verification and was not accessed with an exception. The municipal records may be derived from cadastral data, but the public endpoint does not establish geometry coverage or a stable native identity.
nextStep: Independent serial reviewer should qualify whether an authorized, TLS-valid public Kaski/NeLIS map or geometry endpoint exists before any adapter consideration.
